blocks.text: Fast, efficient & brilliant from all angles – the TCL 50 LE from Tracfone won't let you down. Amazing color, contrast and clarity will be part of your daily routine thanks to NXTVISION Technology and the TCL 50 LE's 90Hz refresh rate. Don't just take pictures, capture ever-lasting memories with a 13MP main camera, 2MP depth camera, and 8MP front-facing selfie cam. Speed through your social feed, stream your favorite movies and download apps in a snap with the TCL 50 LE's powerful MediaTek 2.2GHz Octo-core processor and 4GB of RAM. You'll keep everything you love with 42GB of expandable internal storage and keep the action going for longer with a 4000mAh battery. And stay connected and keep up with those who matter most with our reliable nationwide 4G and 5G coverage. Make brilliance happen every day with the TCL 50 LE from Tracfone. With Tracfone you're always in control with a variety of add-on plans for additional minutes, texts or data when you want, how you want. Plus, every Tracfone plan comes with Unlimited Carryover®, so you keep unused monthly data, texts or minutes for when you need them most*. Unlimited Carryover®: For Unlimited Talk & Text Smartphone plans, any unused data after your service end date will carryover to the next cycle if active service is maintained and in use with any Unlimited Talk & Text Smartphone plan. For other service plans, any unused minutes, texts and data will not expire as long as any Tracfone service plan is active and in use within any six-month period. 5G access requires a 5G-capable device in a 5G coverage area.

items.label: Carrier
items.value: This phone is locked to Tracfone Wireless and can only be used on the Tracfone Wireless network. A Tracfone Wireless plan is required for activation. Activation is simple and can be done online upon receipt of your device following 3 EASY steps. Upon receipt go to Tracfone Wireless website and select "Activate" and follow the prompts.
